names: The Longest Place Name in the World
Hastings (with Havelock North as a spot)
new_destinations.note: Listed for the owner, not added. Hastings is a sizeable second city with its own Wikivoyage chapter and tourism page. Central Hawke's Bay is weaker (Waipukurau stayed review); if declined, its seven members stand alone and the Hastings six become Napier spots (Hastings is 18 km from Napier) or stand alone.

lowest_kept_note: Many kept places have views 0 because Wikipedia has no article or a redirect; they are kept on counted sources (DOC, tourism board, Wikivoyage), not on views. Lowest are views 0 with one counted source (the Central Hawke's Bay beaches, Westshore, Sunrise, Faraday has two). Every non-kept candidate with higher views than 0 is therefore technically stronger; all are listed or covered by the reasons below, with a rule from What qualifies for each.

benchmark: Region-specific: Hawke's Bay holds none of the named NZ benchmarks (Red Rocks, Kapiti Island, Lake Coleridge etc.). The relevant checks pass: Cape Kidnappers and Te Mata Peak kept; Bridge of Remembrance-style minor memorials (Pania of the Reef, Hastings Clock Tower) and ordinary city parks (Cornwall Park, McLean Park) rejected; festivals (Art Deco Festival, Wairoa Maori Film Festival) rejected; a gateway village whose draw is beyond it (Waipukurau/Ongaonga) stayed review; no vehicle/operator spots proposed; the Longest Place Name roadside icon kept like the Ohakune Carrot.
